The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] instigated a '''conspiracy''' to restart the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] after it was ended by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]]. She arranged for the Republic transport [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']] to [[Attack on the Envoy|attack]] an Imperial warship, and framed the Empire for the attack, and the conspiracy culminated in a [[Bombing of the Senate Tower|bombing]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] that almost restarted war. However, the conspiracy ended with Dar'Nala's [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
